set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- Direct, reference, prepared, immutable-source, and mutable-source paths agree across generated shapes, strides, borders, offsets, and empty outputs.
- Primitive Boolean and numerical paths have no per-sample boxing.
- Allocation receipts distinguish preparation from per-run execution.
- Tests cover rank-three and rank-four consumer-shaped workloads.
- JVM, Node, optimized Scala.js, and browser correctness gates pass.
- Performance claims identify the executor, policy, layout class, and reusable workspace used.
set.title: Build stencil conformance and allocation courts
